added.summary: A motion value sets its own scale steps (`nudge`, `lift`, `enter`) under what a recipe's pack sets: bouncy lifts and arrives farther (1.1, from 0.7), snappy and calm less, and stepped (pixel) does not scale at all.

fixed.summary: Each disc sits in the middle of its stop, with its stars across its foot and its Open or Selected word under it; the road runs on from every disc to the next; discs have their fills again (the current one on the accent), so the road no longer shows through a number.
Its panel draws on a phone: a compact-only shape class replaced the theme's panel art with an unfilled cut, so the dialog sat on the bare scene.
A jacket keeps its square beside a long title, and the pressed Preview button takes the primary button's plate, so Previewing reads on it in every theme.
